title: Jorge Messi, father and agent of Argentina great, dies aged 68
excerpt: Lionel Messi’s father and agent Jorge has died at the age of 68 at a medical clinic in the ⁠Argentinian city of ⁠Rosario after ​a long illness, the family have announced
content_html:
Lionel Messi’s father and agent, Jorge, has died aged 68 at a medical clinic in the ⁠Argentinian city of ⁠Rosario after ​a long illness, the family have announced. Jorge Messi spent his final months ⁠alternating between a medical centre in Rosario and his home, accompanied by his wife, Celia, and his ⁠children Rodrigo, Matías and María Sol.

Lionel Messi ​spent time with his ‌father after the World ‌Cup before rejoining his club, Inter Miami, for whom he ‌returned to action a week ago. Inter Miami are due to play Monterrey on Saturday at home in the 2026 Leagues Cup, but the MLS club have yet to announce whether he will feature.

Newell’s Old Boys announced the death in a social media post that said he had undergone treatment in recent months for an unspecified illness. The post described him as “the pillar and the person who, with vision, rigour and affection, supported the career of the best player of all time, alongside his wife, Celia Cuccittini”. The Argentinian FA also expressed its ⁠condolences in a statement, saying: “From here, we stand in solidarity ​with the entire family ​during this difficult time and send ​the most heartfelt, warm, and affectionate embrace. Strength to you all.”

At the World Cup, Lionel Messi said after Argentina’s 3-0 victory over Algeria – when he broke down in ​tears while celebrating ​his first goal in the team’s opening match – that he was going through a difficult personal situation. Later, he explained his tears ​were due ‌to “something unrelated to ​football” after ​going through “a few difficult, complicated days”.

There was speculation that the player’s emotional reaction to Argentina’s last-16 victory over Egypt was due in part to his father’s deteriorating condition. A few days later, the family issued a statement regarding Jorge Messi’s “health situation”, informing the public that he was undergoing medical treatment.

Jorge Messi closely accompanied his son throughout his career, beginning with his early years at Barcelona. He acted as a crucial pillar of support and, for several years, served as his representative. “I always ‌needed my dad’s approval, ever since I was a kid. After every match, I’d ask him ​what he thought of how I played,” said Lionel Messi.

content_html_zh:
莱昂内尔·梅西 (Lionel Messi) 的父亲兼经纪人豪尔赫 (Jorge) 因长期患病，在阿根廷罗萨里奥市的一家医疗诊所去世，享年 68 岁。 豪尔赫·梅西在他生命的最后几个月里，在妻子西莉亚以及孩子罗德里戈、马蒂亚斯和玛丽亚·索尔的陪伴下，在罗萨里奥的一家医疗中心和自己的家之间轮流度过。

世界杯结束后，莱昂内尔·梅西 (Lionel Messi) 与父亲一起度过了一段时光，然后又回到了他的俱乐部迈阿密国际，一周前他又回到了球队。 迈阿密国际队定于周六在 2026 年联赛杯主场迎战蒙特雷，但美国职业足球大联盟俱乐部尚未宣布他是否会参加比赛。

纽维尔老男孩队在社交媒体上宣布了他的死亡消息，称他最近几个月因某种不明疾病接受了治疗。 该帖子将他描述为“与他的妻子西莉亚·库奇蒂尼 (Celia Cuccittini) 一起，以远见、严谨和热情支持有史以来最好球员职业生涯的支柱和人物”。 阿根廷足协也在一份声明中表达了哀悼，并表示：“在此困难时期，我们与全家人团结一致，并致以最衷心、温暖和深情的拥抱。 给你们大家力量。”

在世界杯上，梅西在阿根廷 3-0 战胜阿尔及利亚后表示，他在庆祝球队首场比赛的第一个进球时流下了眼泪，他正在经历一段艰难的个人处境。 后来，他解释说，在经历了“一些困难、复杂的日子”后，他的眼泪是因为“与足球无关的事情”。

有人猜测，这位球员对阿根廷16强战胜埃及队的情绪反应部分是由于他父亲的病情恶化。 几天后，家人就豪尔赫·梅西的“健康状况”发表声明，告知公众他正在接受治疗。

从早年在巴塞罗那开始，豪尔赫·梅西在儿子的整个职业生涯中都密切陪伴着他。 他是他的重要支柱，并多年来担任他的代表。 “从我还是个孩子的时候起，我就一直需要父亲的认可。 每场比赛结束后，我都会问他对我的表现有何看法，”莱昂内尔·梅西说道。
